name: Inverse-Volatility Scaled Portfolio (SPY/TLT/GLD/DBC)
description: Weekly rebalanced inverse-volatility portfolio across SPY, TLT, GLD, and DBC. Uses 40-day realized volatility to compute inv-vol weights (capped at 50% per asset). Benchmarked against equal-weight (25% each). Outputs: stacked weight allocation chart, per-asset rolling volatility, and a cross-sectional metrics summary table.
source:
# Inverse-Volatility Scaled Portfolio
# Universe: SPY (equities), TLT (long bonds), GLD (gold), DBC (commodities)
# Signal: 40-day annualized realized volatility
# Weighting: Inverse-vol, capped at 50% per asset
# Rebalancing: Weekly (first trading day of each week)
# Benchmark: Equal-weight (25% each) shown via normalized equity curve

# ─── Data ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# ─── Volatility Signal ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 40-day annualized historical volatility (feeds close prices directly per S47)
vol_40d = volatility(period=40)(close)

# ─── Rebalance Trigger ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# First trading day of each week
is_new_week = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.week)(index())

# ─── Inverse-Vol Weights (capped at 50%) ─────────────────────────────────────
# Manual implementation: 1/vol → normalize → cap at 50% → renormalize
# Step 1: raw inverse-vol per asset
inv_vol = 1.0 / vol_40d
# Step 2: cross-sectional sum of inv_vol (denominator for normalization)
inv_vol_sum = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Sum)(inv_vol)
# Step 3: normalize so weights sum to 1
raw_w = inv_vol / inv_vol_sum
# Step 4: cap each asset at 50%
capped_w = raw_w if raw_w < 0.5 else 0.5
# Step 5: renormalize after capping so weights still sum to 1
cap_sum = cs_agg(type=AggregationType.Sum)(capped_w)
inv_vol_w = capped_w / cap_sum

# ─── Equal-Weight Benchmark (25% each) ───────────────────────────────────────
# Always-on mask: all 4 assets are always active
always_held = is_valid(close)
eq_w = equal_weight()(always_held)

# ─── Entry Signal: Always Long ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# All assets are always held — the portfolio is fully invested at all times
# Use hold_until to maintain a persistent long signal
long_signal = is_valid(vol_40d)  # True once vol warmup (40 bars) is complete

# ─── Execution ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=long_signal)

# Inv-vol sizing, rebalanced weekly
# inv_vol_w is already in [0, 1] range → multiply by 100 for percent mode
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(
    size=inv_vol_w * 100,
    rebalance_on=is_new_week
)

# ─── Reporters ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# 1. Stacked area chart: inv-vol weight allocation over time
#    Shows how weights shift as relative volatilities change
cs_lines(
    title='Inverse-Vol Weight Allocation Over Time',
    category='Portfolio Weights',
    y_axis_label='Portfolio Weight',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    area=True,
    stack_type=StackType.NormalStack,
    order=1
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(inv_vol_w,))

# 2. Per-asset 40-day rolling volatility over time
#    Shows the vol dynamics driving the weight shifts
cs_lines(
    title='40-Day Realized Volatility by Asset',
    category='Portfolio Weights',
    y_axis_label='Annualized Volatility',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    order=2
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(vol_40d,))

# 3. Cross-sectional summary: current weight, current vol, equal-weight for comparison
#    One row per asset — snapshot of current portfolio state
cs_summary_table(
    title='Current Portfolio Snapshot',
    category='Portfolio Weights',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    order=3
)(inv_vol_w, vol_40d, eq_w)
